note: Lines 1 to 5 are round 1's English narrator lines, unchanged, so new voices compare directly. Lines 7 to 10 are the designer's four sentences, word for word. Number 6 was round 1's French line and is not used here.

lines.text: Above about 26 degrees, the air over the ocean starts to rise.
Not on the equator, though. There's no spin there to start it turning.
In 2005, Hurricane Katrina reached 280 kilometres an hour, and killed more than 1,800 people.
The capital of Iceland is Reykjavík. In French, thank you very much is merci beaucoup.
こんにちは。今日はいい天気ですね。ありがとうございます。
lines.respell: こんにちは。きょうはいい天気ですね。ありがとうございます。
lines.respell_note: The same sentence with 今日 written in kana. Only for an engine whose own front end misreads 今日は; see gen_chatterbox2.py.

lines.text: Buenos días. ¿Cómo estás? Me llamo Rosa y vivo en Sevilla.
Buongiorno. Mi chiamo Giulia, piacere di conoscerti. Grazie mille.
नमस्ते। आप कैसे हैं? मेरा नाम अर्जुन है। धन्यवाद।
